title: EnvironmentRunRequest
description: A request to run an agent/runtime inside a governed, local-first evaluation environment (Repo2RLEnv/Harbor/OpenEnv-style environments are CANDIDATES behind this spine). The spine MEASURES the agent against a declared reward spec; it does not let the agent's output become truth. Deny-by-default: bounded steps + wall-clock timeout, scoped input (by reference or inline), and require_receipt to force an EnvironmentRunReceipt to be emitted. No raw secrets — pass refs in input/input_ref, never inline credentials.

run_id.description: caller-assigned idempotency/correlation id for this run

environment_id.description: id of the environment to run in (resolves to an EnvironmentProviderNode)

agent_id.description: id of the agent/runtime under evaluation (the system-under-test)

tenant_id.description: owning tenant; tenant-private lineage never becomes global

input_ref.description: ResourceRef-style handle to the task input (preferred over inline); exactly one of input_ref or input is expected

input.description: inline task input when small + non-sensitive; exactly one of input_ref or input is expected

max_steps.description: hard upper bound on agent steps (deny-by-default bound)

timeout_ms.description: hard wall-clock budget for the whole run in milliseconds

reward_spec_id.description: id of the RewardSpec to score this run with (deterministic scoring preferred)

require_receipt.description: when true, the run MUST emit an EnvironmentRunReceipt or be treated as unavailable
